description: This Java source file defines a utility class Utils for the SpeedTracker app, used in both handset and wearable components. It provides a method to generate a hash string representing a day based on Calendar input.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class for generating a string hash that uniquely identifies a day, used both in handset and wearable applications.

methods.name: getHashedDay
methods.description: Generates a string hash for a given day by concatenating the year and day of year from a Calendar object.
